description: This file defines the class DefaultSupervisedStream, which implements the SupervisedStream interface for managing streaming processes, including shutdown and abort functionalities using Akka's KillSwitch.

classes.name: DefaultSupervisedStream
classes.description: Implementation of a supervised stream which manages a KillSwitch and completion future for a streaming process.

methods.name: whenComplete
methods.description: Registers a consumer to be invoked when the completion future completes, passing any error that occurred.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the streaming process via the KillSwitch.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the streaming process with a specified error via the KillSwitch.
